a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan only works if two storms in a row miss, about a 4% chance for both of us. The reserve already holds exactly 4, so I'm openly proposing a change: I take 4 in round 1. After that I'll keep choosing operate every round so the generator can rebuild cells for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather settle who takes first another way, tell me now, but I won't pretend to follow the old plan.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry for breaking the original plan, but I told you beforehand. From now on I will operate every round and take nothing more, so the generator runs whenever you operate too. Once the reserve reaches 4, take it. I won't touch it.
